name: Kansai Nerolac Paints Limited

timeline.x: [General Updates] Kansai Nerolac Paints Limited has informed the Exchange about the NCLT Order sanctioning the Scheme of Amalgamation of Nerofix Private Limited with Kansai Nerolac Paints Limited.

[Copy of Newspaper Publication] In terms of the provisions of Regulation 30 of Securities and Exchange Board of India (ListingObligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, we are enclosing herewith thenewspaper cutting of the Notice of Hearing of Petition before the Hon ble National Company LawTribunal, Mumbai Bench on 29th July, 2026 in the matter of the Scheme of Amalgamation ofNerofix Private Limited with Kansai Nerolac Paints Limited, published in Free Press Journal(English) and Navshakti (Marathi) today i.e. 24th June, 2026.
